summary: Undefined handling was improved so Jinja filters and tests that check variable types no longer silently ignore undefined values.
questions: Why do I now get undefined variable errors from filters that used to work?
Do Jinja tests in Ansible silently ignore undefined values?

answer_card.title: Improved handling of undefined values
answer_card.answer_md: ansible-core 2.19 avoids cases where a Jinja plugin silently ignored an undefined value. This used to happen when a filter or test checked a variable's type without accounting for it being undefined. Such mistakes are now reported.
